item.title: Fox seeks full term as Fayette County circuit judge
item.description: As the May election draws closer, a current Fayette County circuit judge says he is ready to serve a full term. Before his appointment, Judge Fox's extensive legal career spanned three decades and saw him deal with cases in 40 counties around the state.
